map.在线计算数学表达式：支持 + - * / % ^ ( ) 与 sin/cos/t: Evaluate math expressions online: supports + - * / % ^ ( ) and functions such as sin/cos/tan/sqrt/abs/ln/log/floor/ceil/round/min/max, and keeps your last 20 calculations automatically.
map.：先括号，再函数与幂，其次乘除，最后加减。: : parentheses first, then functions and exponentiation, then multiplication and division, and finally addition and subtraction.
map.：常用调度场算法（Shunting-yard）把中缀式转为后缀式再求值，避免歧义: : the shunting-yard algorithm is commonly used to convert infix notation to postfix before evaluation, avoiding ambiguity.
map.：三角函数、对数、开方、取模与常量 π、e。: : trigonometric functions, logarithms, roots, modulo, and the constants π and e.
map.执行用户输入，应使用专门的表达式解析器。: to execute user input; use a dedicated expression parser instead.
map.快速计算含括号、函数、常量的复杂算式。: Quickly evaluate complex expressions with parentheses, functions and constants.
map.核对报表口径：把表格里的公式粘进来独立算一遍，确认结果一致，避免引用区域错误导致: Cross-check a report's figures: paste the formula from your spreadsheet and evaluate it independently to confirm the result matches, catching reference errors that skew a whole column.
map.常见 sqrt、pow、sin/cos、log、abs、round 等。: Common ones such as sqrt, pow, sin/cos, log, abs and round.
map.因为二进制浮点无法精确表示十进制的 0.1，二者相加的结果与 0.3 的浮点表示: Because binary floating point cannot represent the decimal 0.1 exactly, so the sum differs from the floating-point representation of 0.3 by a tiny amount. This is inherent to IEEE 754, not a calculation error. When money is involved or exact comparison is needed, use fixed-point numbers, integer minor units, or a dedicated decimal library, and compare with a tolerance rather than an equality operator.
map.字符白名单校验：仅允许数字、+-*/%^()., 空格与函数名字母: Character allowlist validation: only digits, +-*/%^()., spaces, and function-name letters are allowed
map.标识符白名单：仅放行 sin/cos/tan/sqrt/abs/ln/log/f: Identifier allowlist: only sin/cos/tan/sqrt/abs/ln/log/floor/ceil/round/min/max/pi/e pass, and member access (e.g. .constructor) is rejected
map.语法转换：^ → **（幂运算）；数字后 % → (数字/100)（百分比）: Syntax conversion: ^ → ** (exponentiation); a % after a number → (number/100) (percentage)
map.校验通过后才交给 new Function 求值，非法标识符与属性链一律拒绝: Only after validation passes is it handed to new Function for evaluation; illegal identifiers and property chains are always rejected
map.长度限制 ≤200 字符；结果非有限数或抛错 → 提示表达式无效: Length limited to ≤200 characters; a non-finite result or a thrown error → shows an invalid expression message
